headline: Kosmos Energy Stock Sinks on Q3 Earnings and Revenue Miss
summary: Kosmos Energy shares fell after the company reported its third-quarter financial results, missing analyst estimates for both earnings and revenue.
why: Earnings and revenue misses prompt institutional investors to reevaluate growth forecasts and valuation multiples for exploration and production energy firms.

impacts.name: Kosmos Energy Ltd.
impacts.why: Disappointing quarterly earnings and revenue reports typically lead to immediate negative equity price reactions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The company missed consensus analyst estimates for both quarterly earnings and revenue, driving investor sell-offs.
